title: Driver Vehicle Inspection Form
subtitle: Driver Vehicle Inspection: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Driver Vehicle Inspection Form covers power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status. The fleet dispatch coordinator records Driver Vehicle Inspection criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Driver Vehicle Inspection Form keeps Driver Vehicle Inspection exceptions visible until the fleet dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Driver Vehicle Inspection Form at yard, roadside safe area, vehicle cab, exterior walkaround, and trailer. Document power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status identity before Driver Vehicle Inspection begins. Compare power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status findings with stated Driver Vehicle Inspection criteria; route unresolved Driver Vehicle Inspection issues to qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer. For Driver Vehicle Inspection Form, confirm requirements for Driver Vehicle Inspection. Ask qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer to review Driver Vehicle Inspection conditions beyond the fleet dispatch coordinator's role.
